title: Leaks Sometimes When Filling
text: Leaks Sometimes When Filling. Would have given it more stars, but the thing sometimes leaks a bit when filling.  Now that I know, I always check the hot plate before placing the carafe on the hot plate.  I always clean the basket and work the drain spring on the bottom of the basket to make sure it is clear of any grounds.  Basket has leaked from day one.  I use paper filters, so this is the solid plastic basket.  I also miss the automatic shutoff after two hours feature that was on my old Mr Coffee.  I can live with no auto-shutoff, but the leaking is definitely an annoyance.
